description: Modernize the calculators index page (app/(site)/calculators/page.tsx) and the shared CalculatorLayout (components/calculators/CalculatorLayout.tsx) so all 7 calculator pages inherit the modern look. The 7 calculator pages themselves render through CalculatorLayout, so modernizing the layout brings them all in line; only touch individual calculator result/education JSX for accent-tinted result treatment if needed. Absolutely do NOT change any calculator math/logic, input semantics, or the HowTo JSON-LD.
steps: calculators/page.tsx (index): Replace the flat rule-grid of link cells with the homepage modern-card pattern. Each calculator becomes an elevated card: `group relative flex h-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-hairline bg-surface p-6 transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-accent/40 dark:border-hairline-dark dark:bg-elevated dark:hover:border-accent-light/40`, with the soft accent glow span, a gradient icon badge (`inline-flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-accent-gradient text-white shadow-sm` wrapping the existing <LineIcon> with its existing icon name), a .title-link heading, description, and a bottom CTA row 'Open Calculator ->' using text-accent dark:text-accent-light with the nudging arrow (group-hover:gap-2). Use a `grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3` and wrap each card in <Reveal delay={i*0.05}>. Modernize the header block to wrap in <Reveal> and keep the .page-title. Keep the exported `metadata` and the `calculators` array (titles/descriptions/hrefs/icons) unchanged.

CalculatorLayout.tsx: Modernize the shared layout so all 7 calculators inherit it. (a) Breadcrumb links hover to the accent (hover:text-accent dark:hover:text-accent-light). (b) Add an accent-tinted header treatment to the masthead: keep the .page-title and description, optionally add a small gradient icon badge or accent eyebrow rule, but keep it subtle and consistent with the homepage. (c) Convert the two `.panel` blocks (Input Details, Results) into elevated rounded-2xl cards (border border-hairline bg-surface p-6 dark:border-hairline-dark dark:bg-elevated) and replace the oxblood accent-rule section markers (`span.accent-rule` currently oxblood) with an electric-blue accent marker (e.g. a short bg-accent-gradient or bg-accent rule, or a small gradient badge) so section headers read as accent, not oxblood. (d) Keep the educationalContent panel-muted block but ensure it matches (rounded card). (e) Ensure results figures keep tabular-nums (they already do). Do NOT change the component's props/signature (title, description, children, results, educationalContent, jsonLd) or how jsonLd is rendered.

Sanity-check the 7 calculator pages (401k, compound-interest, emi, loan-payoff, mortgage, retirement, sip): they pass results JSX into CalculatorLayout. The result blocks currently use `border-l-2 border-oxblood bg-wash` highlight boxes and eyebrow labels. Update the primary-result highlight box accent from oxblood to the electric-blue accent (e.g. border-l-2 border-accent bg-accent-soft dark:bg-accent/10 or similar) consistently across all 7 so the result emphasis matches the new accent, BUT do not alter any numbers, formatting functions, state, validation, calculate logic, or the generateHowToSchema JSON-LD. This is a same-pattern edit repeated across the 7 files - treat it as part of this one feature.
Verify reduced-motion safety: the card hover lift must include motion-reduce:transform-none (or rely on Reveal for entrance). Keep everything responsive.
acceptance_criteria: The calculators index renders 7 elevated modern cards with gradient icon badges, hover lift + accent border, .title-link titles, and an 'Open Calculator ->' accent CTA, wrapped in Reveal with stagger.
CalculatorLayout uses the electric-blue accent for section markers and breadcrumb hovers (no oxblood section markers remain) and renders Input/Results as elevated rounded cards.
All 7 calculator pages visually inherit the modernized layout; their result highlight boxes use the accent instead of oxblood.
No calculator math, state, validation, formatting, or generateHowToSchema JSON-LD is changed (diff on those code regions is styling/className-only).
`npm run lint` and `npm run build` both pass.
verification: git diff on the 7 calculator page files shows only className/JSX styling changes, no changes to numeric logic, useState, validate, calculate, or generateHowToSchema calls.
findings: Calculators index converted to the homepage modern-card pattern (gradient icon badge, hover lift with motion-reduce:transform-none, accent glow span, .title-link, 'Open Calculator ->' accent CTA, grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3, Reveal stagger delay=i*0.05). Kept exported metadata and the `calculators` array unchanged. CalculatorLayout modernized: breadcrumb hovers now accent (hover:text-accent dark:hover:text-accent-light), added a subtle accent eyebrow 'Calculator' above the page-title, both Input/Results panels converted from `.panel` to elevated rounded-2xl border+bg-surface/elevated cards, oxblood `.accent-rule` section markers replaced with a `h-6 w-0.5 rounded-full bg-accent-gradient` marker, educational block now a rounded-2xl bg-wash card. Props signature (title/description/children/results/educationalContent/jsonLd) and jsonLd rendering are unchanged. 6 of the 7 calculator pages (401k, compound-interest, emi, loan-payoff, mortgage, sip) had their primary result highlight box restyled from `border-l-2 border-oxblood bg-wash ... dark:border-oxblood-light dark:bg-wash-dark` to `border-l-2 border-accent bg-accent-soft ... dark:border-accent-light dark:bg-accent/10` (className-only, single-line diff each). The retirement-calculator was intentionally left untouched: its primary box uses semantic up/down (green/red) directional status colors, not oxblood, so it is not part of the oxblood->accent accent swap. No calculator math/logic, useState, validate(), calculate(), formatting, input semantics, or generateHowToSchema JSON-LD were changed. Note: `.eyebrow-accent`/`.accent-rule` globals utilities are still oxblood-based, so I used explicit accent classes inline rather than those utilities to avoid oxblood section markers. `bg-accent-soft`, `bg-accent-gradient`, `accent-light`, `accent/10` are all valid tokens (tailwind.config.ts). Verified: `npm run lint` -> 'No ESLint warnings or errors'; `npm run build` -> success (postbuild next-sitemap OK).
